entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `DOTNET_TC_CallCountingDelayMs=0` breaks BDN disassembler #117339
  • Provide ability to generate code from JsonSchema #117338
  • Orphaned Link in NativeAOT Limitations Readme File #117337
  • Different Behavior between .NET and .NET Mono when entering Try Block with Non-Zero Stack Height #117335
  • System.Formats.Tar null-terminated strings not trimmed correctly #117331
  • Direct support for UTF8 in System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex #117329
  • When I added a TargetOS type to the build script, some BCL libraries failed to compile #117327
  • Improve the emitter support for APX instructions #117326

Closed

  • Consider not using STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION anymore #45971
  • Dead link on build.sh --help #117320
    10.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [mono][interp] Always sign extend small integers to native integer when returning to compiled code #117336
    area-Codegen-Interpreter-mono
  • Skip null loggers when creating message loggers in Logger factory. #117334
    area-Extensions-Logging, community-contribution
  • Fix `File.Exists` for pipe paths on Windows #117333
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • Constant fold dictionary lookup #117332
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Use `$NOCANCEL` variants of APIs on apple platforms #117330
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Optimize Stack<T>'s enumerator #117328
    area-System.Collections

Merged

  • Fix dead link in build.sh help message to point to correct cross-building documentation #117325

Updated

  • Allow compressed displacement to be used when profitable #117288
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Documentation consistency for PQC types #117323
    area-System.Security, 10.0.0
  • Reporting of type loads via console output and a new event perfcounter #95531
    area-VM-coreclr, new-api-needs-documentation, no-recent-activity, needs-author-action
  • Enable linux-musl, x86, and arm cdac reader packages #117321
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Instrumentation for #116276 #116411
    NO-MERGE, NO-REVIEW
  • [release/9.0-staging][wbt] Prevent `InvalidOperationException` on `TestOutputHelper` logging. #116916
    Servicing-approved, arch-wasm, test-enhancement, area-Infrastructure-mono
  • [NativeAOT] Fix linux-arm stacktraces in crashdumps #117130
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2743333 #115228
    area-Infrastructure-libraries, linkable-framework
  • [cDAC] Ensure cDAC is used in test runs #117100
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
